propositions: In-flight code reviews are killed by auto-deploy container restarts when the 45-second shutdown drain expires before the review completes (measured 260-911s), causing a fail-closed -1 vote that blocks the existing backfill reconciler recovery.
Transient git-fetch timeouts (>300s) are classified as review-error gaps and converted to vote-bearing BLOCK decisions, which the reconciler then treats as already-voted and skips forever.
Increase DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS from 45 to 1200 (matching review timeout) and update docker-compose stop_grace_period to 1320s to allow in-flight reviews to complete without interruption.

For retryable gap reasons (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled), cast NO vote and record the attempt in a new review_attempts table, leaving the change vote-less for reconciler backfill retry.

After N consecutive retryable failures on the same (change_id, revision) pair (default 3), escalate by casting the fail-closed -1 vote with exhaustion note and emitting VOTER_ERROR metric instead of deferring further.
Terminal outcomes (indeterminate, finding, merged-path failures) continue to cast -1 votes; no vote-less deferral happens on actual review completion or real findings.
